notes.title: Update Notes - Tutorial fixes and adjustments
notes.notes:
Made some balance adjustments to how many resources are generated by certain actions. (increased minerals gained from mining, and increased both plants and food from harvesting).  This should allow the tutorial to end in a more reasonable amount of time.
Fixed a bug where a Domestead loaded that was still in the Foundation Stage(the tutorial) were not loading the correct tutorial or making the appropriate objects available to build.

notes.title: Vibrant Visuals Demo Update!
notes.notes:
Demo Patch Notes(Build ID 15301136) Vibrant Visuals Update!:

○ Overhauled the Game's shader system so the game has a more distinctive style
   • Objects will now be outlined green when they are hovered over with the mouse IF they are interactable objects
   • non-interactable objects do not have an outline when hovered

○ Fixed a large hitch that occurred only when hovering over an item in the build menu for the first time, after the first game loaded.

○ Added conversation system, but only basic functionality
   • Characters may talk to each other when they are near each other, this is done passively so it can happen while they are interacting with objects
   • Currently has no effect on Social Need so characters will still need to call the Space Station to regenerate that Need

○ Added buttons to delete, copy, and move objects
   • Hovered objects should be highlighted red after selecting the delete button
   • Hovered objects should be highlighted in blue after selecting the copy or move buttons
   • Cursor image updates to reflect the 3 different states with appropriate icons(these are placeholder and will have improved cursors soon!)
   • Duplicated/Moved items should retain the same rotation and swatch selected texture when placed(swatch textures unavailable in demo)
   • Moved items should not reduce any resources
   • Duplicated items SHOULD reduce the appropriate amount of resources or tell the player if they do not have enough resources

KNOWN ISSUES
○ When adding a new character while editing a male character, the female character will appear with the option to add male options from the customization menu.
○ Closing the Pause Menu can have a hidden tutorial menu that will seem like the game is frozen, you can get out of this by pressing escape.
○ The Construction Panel containing the Delete/Duplicate/Move Buttons is floating above the build menu...this only happens during the tutorial, but only tutorial is available in the demo
